ranks: Marvel Super Heroes (MSH, 2026-06-26): its last 19 (MSH done); Secrets of Strixhaven Commander (SOC, 2026-04-24) and Secrets of Strixhaven (SOS, 2026-04-24): top 50% by EDHREC rank, the next; with the Nth-counter trigger built and the cards it unblocked (Political Triumph, Claim the Kingdom, Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings), plus Stensian Sanguinist rechecked (prepare built)

authored.name: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

blocked.name: Frozen in Ice
blocked.why: 'Enchanted creature loses all abilities and can't become untapped' — no static lose-all-abilities, and nothing stops a permanent untapping by any means (doesntUntap is only its own untap step, only on itself).

blocked.name: Storm, Windrider
blocked.why: cantAttackController also protects your planeswalkers (Storm says only 'you'); a cast-spell trigger can't name 'those creatures' the triggering spell targets.

blocked.name: Misty Knight, Hero for Hire
blocked.why: No amount counting the cards you've discarded this turn (discardedOnTurn is a per-card marker, lost when the card leaves the graveyard).

blocked.name: Quicksilver, Brash Blur
blocked.why: No opening-hand 'begin the game with him on the battlefield'.

blocked.name: Ms. Marvel, Kamala Khan
blocked.why: Until end of turn she gains a power-setting CDA ('base power equal to the cards in your hand', live); no effect grants a static/CDA for a duration.

blocked.name: Avengers Disassembled
blocked.why: 'Its controller may search' — a decline still searches and shuffles (docs/engine-gaps.md).

blocked.name: Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes
blocked.why: No filter for a graveyard card 'put there from anywhere this turn' (only putIntoGraveyardFromLibraryThisTurn).

blocked.name: Wolverine, Fierce Fighter
blocked.why: 'Instead that damage is dealt, but all other damage already dealt to him is healed' — no damage replacement that removes marked damage.

blocked.name: Hawkeye, Master Marksman
blocked.why: 'You may pay {1} up to three times. When you do, choose up to that many' modes.

blocked.name: Loki Laufeyson
blocked.why: Rechecked: fireCastWatchers matches the nextSpell filter with only { you }, so an { amount: { powerOf: 'source' } } operand ('mana value <= Loki's power', read as the spell is cast) has no context and fails closed.

blocked.name: Death to Our Enemies
blocked.why: 'When you do, it deals 7 damage divided among one or two targets' is a reflexive trigger, and ReflexiveTrigger carries only targets/effect/text: no `divided`, so no split is asked or kept (game.ts reads `(ability as TriggeredAbility).divided` off the reflexive record, always undefined).

blocked.name: Elektra, Daughter of the Hand
blocked.why: Sneak (return an unblocked attacker during declare blockers, cast, enters tapped and attacking) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Vision Quest
blocked.why: search-library to the battlefield has no 'with X additional +1/+1 counters' (it must enter with them, rule 614.1c), nor a way to give 'it' (the found card) haste afterward.

blocked.name: Ribtruss Roaster
blocked.why: Devour isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Scriv, the Obligator
blocked.why: No 'create an Aura token attached to target creature' (it must be created attached, and not at all if it can't enchant it — the ruling); Contract's 'if it's attacking one of your opponents' (the Aura controller's opponents) has no condition.

blocked.name: Brass Infiniscope
blocked.why: Its nextSpell delayed trigger ('gain half X life') needs the trigger spell's X as it is on the stack (or last was) when it resolves; fireCastWatchers queues the delayed trigger with no x, and no EffectAmount reads the trigger spell's X.

blocked.name: Topiary Lecturer
blocked.why: Increment's intervening-if compares the trigger spell's mana spent with the source's power/toughness; a trigger-object filter's { amount } operand fails closed in conditionMet's matchesKnown (no FilterContext.amount), so nothing can say it.

blocked.name: Joined Researchers // Secret Rendezvous
blocked.why: No StaticCondition for 'if an opponent has more cards in hand than you' (hand-size is only your own bounds or each player's; opponent-controls-more counts permanents).

blocked.name: Molten-Core Maestro
blocked.why: Opus resolves even if the spell was countered (ruling), but moveObject clears manaSpent on stack->graveyard and lastOnStack/LastKnownInfo don't keep it for a spell, so a trigger-object { manaSpent } check reads 0 — proved in a scratch test (countered 5-mana spell: no {R} added).

blocked.name: Exhibition Tidecaller
blocked.why: Same opus gap: 'if five or more mana was spent to cast that spell' reads 0 once the spell has been countered in response, so it would mill three instead of ten.

blocked.name: Ark of Hunger
blocked.why: 'Mill a card. You may play that card this turn' needs a one-shot *play* permission (lands included) for the milled card in the graveyard; grant-graveyard-cast is cast-only and targeted.

blocked.name: Ral Zarek, Guest Lecturer
blocked.why: The -7's 'target opponent skips their next X turns' has no vocabulary.

blocked.name: Petrified Hamlet
blocked.why: 'Choose a land card name' as it enters, then a named-source prohibition and grant, isn't built.

blocked.name: Stensian Sanguinist // Exsanguinate
blocked.why: "whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this combat": the dealsCombatDamage delayed watch lasts the turn, so an extra combat would fire it again
